welcome_subtitle: Paste a device pairing link to sign in in one step, or enter your Hub address. Persona Link is optional.
settings_subtitle: Manage your Hub connection, Persona Link, and desktop behavior.
hub_help: Paste a pairing link to sign in in one step, or enter your Hub address.
hub_hint: Supports persona://pair links, sign-in URLs with a token, or a Hub URL (with subpath if used).
hint_pair_detected: Pairing link detected — connects and signs in automatically
hint_token_detected: Sign-in link detected — signs in automatically
hint_link_detected_title: This is a Persona Link for this computer
hint_link_detected_body: This pairs this computer's Agent service rather than signing in your account. Pair it first, then sign in to your Hub.
help_toggle: Where do I get a pairing link?
help_step_1: On a signed-in phone or browser, open Devices in Settings and choose Connect a new device. On Apple and the web, Devices is under Advanced.
help_step_2: Copy the pairing link and paste it above — no second login needed.
help_step_3: Or run personad hub pair in the terminal on your Hub machine.
desktop_options_help: Behavior of the Persona desktop app on this computer.
launch_at_login: Open Persona when you sign in to this computer
launch_requires_approval: macOS needs your approval in System Settings before Persona can open at sign-in.
link_intro: Persona Link is a separate, optional background service. You do not need it to chat or use Agents on another computer.
link_absent: Persona Link is not installed. Install it separately only if this computer should run Agents.
link_install_guide: Persona Link is a separate install for running Agents on this computer. Open your hub's Machines › Add Computer page and follow its Persona Link steps, then return here to pair. This desktop app does not install a background service without your choice.
pair_hint: Paste the persona://link?… link or the full persona-link pair command.
pair_success_hub_ready: Paired — open your Hub to sign in
hub_invalid: Check the Hub address or pairing link and try again.
err_invalid_url_body: Enter an http:// or https:// Hub address, or paste a persona://pair?… link.
err_cert_untrusted_body: This Hub uses a self-signed TLS certificate that your system doesn't trust by default.
err_cert_untrusted_tip_1: Recommended: paste a persona://pair?… link (or #token link from your phone) — it carries the Hub's certificate fingerprint and verifies it automatically.
err_cert_untrusted_tip_2: Or connect with a trusted HTTPS domain (via reverse proxy) or your local LAN HTTP address.
err_cert_pin_mismatch_body: The Hub's TLS key differs from the fingerprint in your link. Generate a fresh pairing link from the Hub and try again.
err_cert_expired_body: Check the clock on this computer and renew the TLS certificate on your Hub.
err_tls_protocol_body: If you entered https:// on a plain HTTP port (such as 18660), try http:// or switch to the Hub's TLS port (such as 18662 with a pairing link).
err_connection_refused_body: Check that personad is running on the Hub machine and the port is reachable.
err_dns_failed_body: Check the hostname spelling and make sure your network or DNS can reach this Hub.
err_timeout_body: The Hub didn't respond in time. Check firewalls, VPN, or whether the Hub is online.
err_offline_body: Check your network connection and try again.
err_unknown_body: Check the address and make sure the Hub is running and reachable.
hub_connection_failed: Persona couldn't reach your hub. Your saved address and sign-in are kept on this computer. Check the hub machine's connection, then retry.
hub_connection_retry_failed: The hub still can't be reached. Check its connection and retry.
link_footer: Link and the resident node keep running without this app. Only install them on a computer you want the hub to reach.
claude_plugin: Keep the Persona plugin for Claude Code installed
claude_plugin_installed: Installed, version {version}. New Claude Code sessions use it.
claude_plugin_outdated: Version {version} is installed; Persona Link updates it.
claude_plugin_disabled: Turned off in Claude Code. Persona leaves it off until you turn this on again.
claude_plugin_claude_missing: Claude Code is not on this computer.
claude_plugin_unavailable: This computer's Persona node has no plugin to install. Update the node first.
claude_plugin_error: The last check failed. Persona Link tries again soon.
update_failed: Couldn't check for updates. Persona will try again later.
